prompt:
How many kilometers of electric transmission line rated 345 kV or more run through FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area in Harris County, Texas?

Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q7_2

output.method: I took the HIFLD Transmission Lines dataset (94,619 features, WGS84), kept lines with VOLTAGE >= 345 kV, and reprojected them to UTM 15N. I took the Harris County NFHL S_FLD_HAZ_AR polygons with SFHA_TF = 'T' (dissolved to remove overlaps), clipped the lines to them, and summed the clipped lengths in meters, giving 162,840.7 m across 30 line segments. The data has only 345 kV lines in the county (no 500 kV or 765 kV), and the total includes lines whose status is listed as NOT AVAILABLE.

args.sql: SELECT VOLTAGE, VOLT_CLASS, STATUS, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tl WHERE bbox.xmin <= -94.9 AND bbox.xmax >= -95.95 AND bbox.ymin <= 30.18 AND bbox.ymax >= 29.5 GROUP BY VOLTAGE, VOLT_CLASS, STATUS ORDER BY VOLTAGE

parts.content:
Clip (native:clip)

----------------
Description
----------------
This algorithm clips a vector layer using the features of an additional polygon layer. Only the parts of the features in the Input layer that fall within the polygons of the Overlay layer will be added to the resulting layer.

The attributes of the features are not modified, although properties such as area or length of the features will be modified by the clipping operation. If such properties are stored as attributes, those attributes will have to be manually updated.

----------------
Arguments
----------------

INPUT: Input layer
	Argument type:	source
	Acceptable values:
		- Path to a vector layer
OVERLAY: Overlay layer
	Argument type:	source
	Acceptable values:
		- Path to a vector layer
OUTPUT: Clipped
	Argument type:	sink
	Acceptable values:
		- Path for new vector layer

----------------
Outputs
----------------

OUTPUT: <outputVector>
	Clipped
